dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Steelers (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Thursday Injury Report Ahead of Broncos
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Pittsburgh opened G Gennings Dunker's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for S DeShon Elliott (knee), LB Cole Holcomb (heel), and LB Nick Herbig (hip / ribs). LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf) did not practice Thursday, while G Gennings Dunker (knee) and WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot (plantar fasciitis)) practiced in full [Ryland Bickley](https://www.behindthesteelcurtain.com/pittsburgh-steelers-analysis/178573/the-aaron-rodgers-steelers-breakup-is-the-weirdest-nfl-story-in-a-long-time-mike-mccarthy-2027-roster).

Week 12 Broncos Outlook: Mike McCarthy and DC Patrick Graham open installation for the Denver Broncos (8-2, DEN -3.5, HC Sean Payton, OC Davis Webb & DC Vance Joseph (Acrisure Stadium)) as Pittsburgh prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Brooke Pryor](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50597989/steelers-players-try-keep-focus-broncos-amid-rodgers-fallout) [Ryland Bickley](https://www.behindthesteelcurtain.com/pittsburgh-steelers-injuries/178593/steelers-nick-herbig-still-limited-ahead-of-broncos-game-injury-report-black-friday-aaron-rodgers-deshon-elliott).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (2nd in AFC North • #7 Seed in AFC), Pittsburgh carries a 68.4% postseason projection, 11.7% AFC North division title mark, and 0.3% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50597133/aaron-rodgers-pat-mcafee-interview-social-reaction).

Around the Beat: Approximately 15 hours after they announced quarterback Aaron Rodgers’ demotion on Tuesday night, the Steelers are waiving the future Hall of Famer, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/aaron-rodgers-on-steelers-tenure-that-ship-has-sailed).
